verdict.line: You lose if you all-in before crossing 50 Fury or trade in open lane where she has no wall for Hookshot leverage; you win if you force fights level 3-10 where your stun-lock burst outpaces her short-cooldown poke.

brief.thesis: Renekton wins this at 51.7% over 775 games because his full kit (Q/W/E) comes online by level 3 while Camille's E (Hookshot) only functions as an engage tool near a wall — away from walls she has no way to force a fight on her terms. The deciding resource is your own Fury bar: cross 50 before you commit and your W goes from a 0.75s double-stun to a 1.5s triple-slash that also strips her passive shield.

theirWindow.when: Camille near a wall, E and Q up
theirWindow.what: She can Hookshot to the wall and leap off to knock you up, then follow with an empowered Q auto and her Tactical Sweep cone. Back off from walls or bait E before you commit anything.

yourWindow.when: your Fury is above 50, her E is down
yourWindow.what: Land your empowered W first — it destroys the physical shield from her Adaptive Defenses passive and stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s — then dash in with E and finish with Q for the sustain.

start.why: The lifesteal and auto damage let you trade autos to build Fury toward the 50 threshold without losing the sustain war against her passive shield.

boots.why: Both her Q-empowered auto and her Tactical Sweep cone hit as physical damage; the flat reduction blunts her main poke and all-in tools.

core.why: Rewards landing two hits in the same trade window, which your empowered W (double/triple slash) does naturally.
Its armor shred stacks with your E's own armor reduction, so your follow-up W and Q hit progressively harder in the same fight.
Smooths out the damage you take from her Q pokes and W cone while you close the gap to fight.

situational.when: you are ahead and need to survive her rank-6+ Hextech Ultimatum all-in
you are snowballing and want faster Q/W/E cooldowns to keep the Fury loop going
she is kiting your engages with Q's move speed and you need to close gaps faster

runes.keystoneWhy: The burst amplification lands cleanly on a target you've just stunned with empowered W, converting your combo's guaranteed hits into a spike big enough to win the all-in outright.

summoners.why: Renekton holds the solo-kill advantage in this matchup, and Ignite is what converts a won all-in into an actual kill instead of a reset.

playing.title: Bank Fury before committing
playing.detail: Auto-attack her once or twice before your all-in so you're past 50 Fury when you cast W — that's the difference between a 0.75s stun and a 1.5s stun that also strips her shield.

playing.title: Break her shield with empowered W
playing.detail: Her Adaptive Defenses passive shields her on your first hit; your empowered W specifically destroys damage shields on the target, so land it before your real damage combo.

playing.title: Only respect E near walls
playing.detail: Camille's Hookshot needs a wall to leap off of and knock you up — away from lane walls she has no engage tool, so shove and trade freely there.

playing.title: Sidestep her W cone
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep blasts after a delay, so move the moment she starts the cast; getting caught in the outer half slows you and heals her.

playing.title: All-in on your level 6 spike
playing.detail: Dominus's bonus health, area damage, and periodic Fury generation let you win extended fights that her short-cooldown kit (Q 5-9s, W 10-12s, E 12-16s) can't sustain.

playing.title: Punish her delayed Q recast
playing.detail: If she waits before recasting Precision Protocol it hits much harder — don't stand still after she lands the first proc, or you eat the bigger second hit.

playing.title: Build Black Cleaver early in trades
playing.detail: Its shred plus your E's own armor reduction means your third and fourth hits in a fight do noticeably more than your first.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/sample numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own analysis, not sourced from OP.GG.
